items.t: Zillow Group (ZG) Unveiled Four New Real Estate Tools
items.sum: Zillow Group (NasdaqGS:ZG) has rolled out four new digital tools focused on home buying, renting, and selling workflows. The release includes a credit-integrated home budgeting feature that lets users align property searches with their actual borrowing capacity. items.t: Zillow launches tools to help answer moving's hardest questions
items.sum: Moving often comes down to four questions: How much can I afford? Where should I live? Which home is the one? Who should I trust to help? Zillow® today announced four tools to help people answer these questions so they can rent or buy with more confidence.

items.t: 1 in 4 Americans have hidden in the bathroom to survive the holidays
items.sum: For nearly 1 in 4 Americans, the best seat in the house during the holidays may be behind a locked bathroom door (23%). A new Zillow® survey conducted by The Harris Poll finds that, whether it's in a bathroom, a bedroom or a car, two-thirds of Americans (66%) admit to hiding somewhere to get a few minutes of peace away from their holiday guests. items.t: Mortgage rates move higher again as inflation jitters mount: Mortgage and refinance interest rates today, Thursday, November 19, 2026
items.sum: The average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rate was 7.28% this week through Wednesday, according to Freddie Mac data, up from 7.11% a week earlier.
